//overrides: next 15.5.x still resolves postcss <=8.5.22 (4 HIGH advisories:
GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93 XSS, GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q / GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 /
GHSA-fxqj-rqcc-2cmp sourceMappingURL path traversal) and sharp
<0.35.0 (GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj, inherited libvips CVEs). npm's own
remediation for both is `next@16`, a framework major that does not
belong on a CI-repair PR. These overrides lift the two transitives
to their patched releases instead — the standard npm mechanism for
a fix the parent package has not picked up yet. Both bumps are
low-risk here: postcss is a patch bump, and sharp is never
exercised at all because next.config.ts sets output:'export' with
images.unoptimized. Drop these once next ships a 15.5.x that
resolves the patched versions, or when the next@16 migration lands.
nanoid <3.3.18 (GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8, custom generators loop
indefinitely when size=0) is pulled in transitively by postcss
(itself already overridden above) via both @tailwindcss/postcss
and next. postcss's own package.json already declares
"nanoid": "^3.3.17", so this override is a patch bump within
postcss's own accepted range — pure lockfile staleness, not a
postcss-vs-nanoid version conflict. Drop once postcss ships a
release that resolves nanoid>=3.3.18 on its own.
